3.name: Hunter's Prey
3.description: Choose Colossus Slayer (+1d8 once per turn vs injured foes), Giant Killer (reaction counter vs Large+), or Horde Breaker (extra attack vs adjacent foe).

7.name: Defensive Tactics
7.description: Choose Escape the Horde (Disadvantage on opportunity attacks against you), Multiattack Defense (+4 AC vs repeat hits), or Steel Will (Adv vs Frightened).

11.name: Multiattack
11.description: Choose Volley (ranged attack against every enemy within 10 ft of a point) or Whirlwind Attack (melee attack against all foes within 5 ft).

15.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
15.description: Choose Evasion (avoid half/all DEX save damage), Stand Against the Tide, or Uncanny Dodge (halve incoming attack damage as Reaction).

colossus_slayer.name: Colossus Slayer
colossus_slayer.hint: Once per turn, against a creature already below its hit point maximum.

3.name: Ranger's Companion
3.description: Bond with a CR <= 1/4 Medium or smaller Beast (or TCoE Primal Companion) adding your Proficiency Bonus to its AC, attacks, damage, saves, and skills.

7.name: Exceptional Training
7.description: Command your beast to Dash, Disengage, or Help as a Bonus Action; its attacks count as magical.

11.name: Bestial Fury
11.description: Your beast companion can make two attacks when you command it to take the Attack action.

15.name: Share Spells
15.description: When you cast a spell targeting yourself, you can also affect your beast companion within 30 ft.

3.name: Dread Ambusher & Umbral Sight
3.description: Add WIS modifier to Initiative, +10 ft turn-1 speed & extra turn-1 weapon attack (+1d8 damage), gain 60 ft Darkvision (+30 ft if already have it) and invisibility to Darkvision in darkness.

7.name: Iron Mind
7.description: Gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws (or Intelligence/Charisma if already proficient in WIS).

11.name: Stalker's Flurry
11.description: Once per turn when you miss with a weapon attack, make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

15.name: Shadowy Dodge
15.description: Reaction imposes Disadvantage on an attack roll against you before knowing if it hits.

dread_ambusher.name: Dread Ambusher
dread_ambusher.hint: First turn of combat: +10ft walking speed, one extra weapon attack that deals extra weapon damage on hit.

3.name: Detect Portal & Planar Warrior
3.description: Action senses planar portals within 1 mile; Bonus Action converts your next weapon attack's damage into Force damage and adds +1d8 Force.

7.name: Ethereal Step
7.description: Bonus Action casts Etherealness until turn end (1/Short or Long Rest).

11.name: Distant Strike
11.description: Teleport 10 ft before each weapon attack and gain a 3rd attack against a distinct creature; Planar Warrior scales to +2d8 Force.

15.name: Spectral Defense
15.description: Reaction halves all damage from a hitting attack against you by turning briefly ethereal.

planar_warrior.name: Planar Warrior
planar_warrior.hint: Bonus action: all attack damage becomes force damage, plus extra force damage.

distant_strike.name: Distant Strike
distant_strike.hint: Attack action: teleport up to 10ft before each attack. Attack 2 different foes to make a 3rd attack.

spectral_defense.name: Spectral Defense
spectral_defense.hint: Reaction: when you take damage from an attack, give yourself resistance to all of that attack's damage.

3.name: Hunter's Sense & Slayer's Prey
3.description: Action discerns target's resistances/immunities/vulnerabilities (WIS mod/Long Rest); Bonus Action deals +1d6 damage once per turn to a chosen quarry.

7.name: Supernatural Defense
7.description: Add +1d6 to any saving throw or grapple escape caused by your Slayer's Prey target.

11.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
11.description: Reaction forces your foe to make a WIS save or its spell/teleport fails (1/Short or Long Rest).

15.name: Slayer's Counter
15.description: When your Slayer's Prey forces a save, Reaction lets you make a weapon attack; hitting automatically passes the save.

3.name: Dreadful Strikes & Otherworldly Glamour
3.description: Weapon hits deal +1d4 Psychic once per creature per turn (+1d6 at L11); add WIS modifier to Charisma checks and gain a social skill.

7.name: Beguiling Twist
7.description: Adv vs Charmed/Frightened; Reaction redirects a failed/succeeded Charm/Fear save onto another foe within 120 ft.

11.name: Fey Reinforcements
11.description: Cast Summon Fey without material components (1/Long Rest or slot) and optionally remove Concentration (1 min duration).

15.name: Misty Wanderer
15.description: Cast Misty Step PB times/Long Rest without a slot, bringing one willing creature within 5 ft.

3.name: Gathered Swarm
3.description: Learn Mage Hand; once per turn on hit, have your swarm deal +1d6 Piercing damage, move target 15 ft (STR save), or move you 5 ft.

7.name: Writhing Tide
7.description: Bonus Action gains a 10-ft Fly Speed and hover for 1 minute (PB/Long Rest).

11.name: Mighty Swarm
11.description: Swarm damage increases to 1d8, pushes knock target Prone, and self-moves grant Half Cover.

15.name: Swarming Dispersal
15.description: Reaction halves incoming damage and teleports 30 ft (PB/Long Rest).

3.name: Draconic Gift & Drake Companion
3.description: Learn Draconic & Thaumaturgy; Action summons a Small elemental Drake Companion obeying Bonus Action commands with Infused Strikes (+1d6 elemental damage).

7.name: Bond of Fang and Scale
7.description: Mount your Medium Drake (cannot fly while mounted yet), its bites add +1d6 elemental damage, and you gain Resistance to its chosen element.

11.name: Drake's Breath
11.description: Exhale (you or Drake) an 8d6 elemental 30-ft cone DEX save (1/Long Rest or 3rd+ spell slot; 10d6 at L15).

15.name: Perfected Bond
15.description: Drake becomes Large (fly while mounted), Infused Strikes rises to +2d6, and Reaction halves damage to either of you (PB/Long Rest).
